title: Package Eligibility and Placement, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Underwriting Guide
content:
A coverage package of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy is available to a policy only when every one of that package's entry gates holds on the rating date. The figures for each gate are those of the package concerned.

## 1. The entry gates

All gates are counted across the rated drivers on the policy; excluded drivers do not count.

- Major violations in the lookback at or below the package's maximum for major violations.
- Minor violations in the lookback at or below the package's maximum for minor violations.
- Chargeable at-fault accidents in the lookback at or below the package's maximum for at-fault accidents.
- The named insured first licensed at least the package's minimum number of full years ago.
- At least the package's minimum months of continuous prior insurance immediately before new business. At renewal and on a package change, Cardinal tenure counts as prior insurance.
- The named insured at least the package's minimum age.

The incident counts used for eligibility are the same counts used for surcharges: violations of each kind and chargeable at-fault accidents, counted by incident date over the lookback ending on the rating date. **A forgiven accident or forgiven minor violation still counts for eligibility.**

## 2. Requirement on the requested package

The requested package must satisfy every entry gate of that package on the rating date. This is decided from the company's records for the drivers: driving records (type, incident date, amount paid), each driver's first-licensed date and date of birth, and the customer's prior insurance months. The facts are read for the driver concerned in the transaction.

## 3. Placement by occasion

| Occasion | Result |
|---|---|
| New business | The customer is offered the highest-ranked package, among those requested, whose gates hold. A request for a package whose gates fail is declined for that package only. |
| Renewal, current package still passes | Renewed on the current package. |
| Renewal, current package no longer passes | Renewed on the highest-ranked package below it whose gates hold; the renewal offer names that package. |
| Renewal, no package passes | The company nonrenews under the renewal rules. |
| Adding a driver whose records would make the policy fail its current package | Not processed as a driver add on that package. The named insured may instead exclude the driver (where the package allows a named driver exclusion) or move to a lower package (where the package allows a change during the term). |

## 4. Licence status of a driver being added

A driver whose license status is suspended or revoked can be added as a rated driver only when a state order on file requires a financial-responsibility filing for that driver and the package has sr22 eligibility, that is, it may carry a financial-responsibility filing. Both conditions are read from system records for that driver. A driver with an expired license cannot be added until it is renewed.

| License status of the driver | State order requiring a filing on file | Package may carry a filing | Driver may be added as rated |
|---|---|---|---|
| Suspended or revoked | Yes | Yes | Yes, subject to the other rules |
| Suspended or revoked | No | either | No |
| Suspended or revoked | either | No | No |
| Expired | either | either | No, until renewed |

## 5. Hypothetical illustration

At renewal, a Cardinal Auto Premier policy's rated drivers show two minor violations in the lookback, the earlier of which is forgiven for surcharge purposes under the package's minor violation forgiveness. Both still count here: two minor violations exceed the Cardinal Auto Premier maximum of 1, so the policy no longer passes. It is renewed on the highest-ranked package below Cardinal Auto Premier whose gates all hold, and the renewal offer names that package.
